channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Opinion: A Hawk is not the same as a Hawkeye
item.description: This was emphasized to people watching a Senate hearing this week, where confusion over two basketball teams was on display.

item.title: The Supreme Court faces another term jam-packed with controversy
item.description: The Supreme Court term opens on Monday with big test cases on religion, guns and climate change. Plus, the emergency docket keeps popping.

item.title: Brazil's big political rematch: What to know about the Brazilian election
item.description: Four years after President Lula narrowly defeated Jair Bolsonaro, Brazil is back at the ballot box. This time, Lula faces Bolsonaro's son, Flávio, in a high-stakes rematch.

item.title: As Trump's proposed arch looms over D.C., protesters pin their hopes on the midterms
item.description: Democratic lawmakers, veterans and concerned citizens gathered in Memorial Circle to protest the arch Trump wants to build there. Their hopes lie primarily in a lawsuit and next month's midterms.

item.title: Trump drops Republican Senator's phone number in social post over fury on stalled bill
item.description: President Donald Trump posted Tom Cotton's alleged cell phone number on Truth Social, urging Arkansas voters to pressure him on daylight saving time.

item.title: Firebrand GOP rep: Democrats side with Iran 'simply because they hate' Trump
item.description: Rep. Randy Fine discusses the rationale for backing the conflict in Iran, explains the meaning of an America First foreign policy, and denounces Rep. Ilhan Omar on immigration fraud

item.title: Springsteen, other stars share stage with hardcore leftist groups at music fest
item.description: Bruce Springsteen and Dave Matthews headline a "Power To The People" festival featuring anti-Trump nonprofits mobilizing ahead of midterms.

item.title: Trump education official says school choice program will put pressure on Dem-led states
item.description: Over half of U.S. states joined Trump's Federal Scholarship Tax Credit, and a top Education Department official says blue states face pressure.

item.title: Newsom slaps 25% tax on private detention centers in sweeping pushback against key Trump policy
item.description: Gavin Newsom signed a 25% tax on private detention centers in California, targeting every ICE facility in the state and their profits directly.

item.title: Body-cam footage shows moment Luigi Mangione was arrested at a McDonald’s
item.description: Newly released video records his arrest in Pennsylvania in connection with the shooting of health care executive Brian Thompson.

item.title: Governor slams district attorney, Cornell police on handling of rape allegations
item.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul (D) also called on legislators to tighten a law limiting the ability to prosecute sexual assault if a victim voluntarily became intoxicated.

item.title: Another disappointing jobs report suggests more challenges for Trump, GOP
item.description: The unemployment rate ticked up to 4.2 percent while wages continued to lag behind inflation in the government’s final jobs report before the Nov. 3 midterm election.

item.title: Trump announces plan to send $90 payments to millions of seniors
item.description: The White House said the one-time payments would be drawn from a fund set up to improve Medicare.

item.title: A record number of Native Americans are running in the 2026 midterms
item.description: At least 355 Native American and Indigenous candidates ran or are running in local, state and federal primary and general elections this year — a record number.

item.title: Why this Democrat is struggling in a state that rejects Trump
item.description: New Hampshire’s Senate race is considered a toss-up thanks to voters’ independent streak and the GOP candidate’s name recognition.

item.title: Four fears and frustrations that are shaping Brazil’s election. One is Trump.
item.description: Officials in Brazil have grown increasingly concerned about the possibility of U.S. interference in the presidential vote on Sunday.

item.title: Trump revisits the scene of his political ascent as Republicans struggle
item.description: A month before the midterms, the president returned to Alabama and other places where his movement remains strongest.

item.title: Trump heads back to Texas on Wednesday as GOP fights to keep state red
item.description: Texas, long a safe Republican state, has emerged as a top battleground in midterm races up and down the ballot — but especially in the U.S. Senate race.

item.title: DOJ probe into Trump foes sees another prominent departure
item.description: Kurt Olsen, who previously worked as Trump’s election security czar, resigned from the “grand conspiracy” investigation on Monday.

item.title: Ex-congressman and Rubio ally gets 10 years for secret Venezuela lobbying
item.description: Former congressman David Rivera (R-Florida) maintained that, despite a $50 million lobbying contract from Venezuela’s government, he advocated for the removal of President Nicolás Maduro.
